যিহোশাফাত বিপদে পড়েছিলেন। তিনি সদ্যই শুনেছিলেন যে একটি বিশাল সংখ্যক সৈন্য তাঁর বিরুদ্ধে লড়তে এসে রয়েছেন। সেই মুহূর্তে তিনি যা করলেন আমরা সবাই স্বাভাবিকভাবেই করি যখন সমস্যা আমাদের বিরুদ্ধে একের পর এক আসে। তিনি ভয় পান। কতোবারই না আমি সেই ভয়ের অনুভূতি জানি, সেই ভয় যে সময়ে সময়ে আমার হৃদয় জড়িয়ে ধরে। কখনো তা বড় জিনিস—ভুলভাবে বোঝা এবং অন্যায়ভাবে ব্যবহার হওয়া, রোগের ভয় ও ব্যথা, অথবা প্রিয়জনের মৃত্যু। কখনো তা ছোট জিনিস—রবিবার বিকেলের একাকিত্ব। এটি আর আরামদায়ক নয়, ঈশ্বর, এবং আমি ভয় পাই।

যিহোশাফাত তাঁর ভয়কে ত্যাগ করলেন, প্রভুকে খুঁজে বের করতে মন দিলেন, এবং জুদা রাজ্যের সমস্ত দেশে উপবাস ঘোষণা করলেন –verse 3. এই মনে হতে পারে অসম্ভব পরিস্থিতিতেই যেখানে হাজার হাজার লোক তাঁদের ধ্বংস করতে আসছিলেন, তিনি প্রভুর সামনে পড়ে তাঁর পরিপূর্ণ, সর্বশক্তিমান শাসন স্বীকার করলেন। এবং [তিনি] বললেন, হে প্রভু ঈশ্বর, আমাদের পিতৃপুরুষদের ঈশ্বর, না কি তুমিই স্বর্গে ঈশ্বর নও? আর না কি তুমিই সমস্ত জাতিগোষ্ঠীর কাছের রাজ্যসমূহে শাসন করো? আর কি তোকেই না শক্তি ও বল গৃহে আছে, যেন কোনো একটাও তোমার বাধা দিতে পারে না? –verse 6.

চয়েসটি আমার। আমি নিজের ভীত চিন্তাগুলোর সঙ্গে লড়াই করি, সেগুলোকে বারবার ঘুরাই যেন কোনোভাবে আমার জটিল ও ভীত মিলনায়তনে পরিস্থিতি বদলে যাবে। ভয়ের সঙ্গে আঁকড়ে রাখা আমাকে নিয়ন্ত্রণে থাকার একটি অনুভূতি দেয়। কিন্তু তা আমাকে ভিতর থেকে ধ্বংস করছে, এমনকি ভীতিকর “যদি” গুলো বাস্তবে পরিণত না হলেও। অবশেষে, আমি ছেড়ে দিই এবং ক্লান্ত হয়ে আমার প্রভুর পায়ে পড়ি, এবং আমার হৃদয় যিহোশাফাত, জুদার রাজা, যে কথা বলেছিলেন তা উচ্চারণ করে।

নমনীয় আবেদনেই যিহোশাফাত তাদের দুর্বলতা ও ঈশ্বরের শক্তির প্রয়োজন স্বীকার করেন। হে আমাদের ঈশ্বর, তুমি কি তাদের বিচার করবে না? কারণ আমাদের কাছে এই বড় দলকে, যা আমাদের বিরুদ্ধে আসে, কোনো শক্তি নেই; আমরা জানি না কি করতে হবে: কিন্তু আমাদের চোখ তোমার প্রতি নিবদ্ধ আছে। –verse 12.

হ্যাঁ, ঈশ্বর, আমি বিষয়গুলোর বিস্তৃত চিত্রে কিছুই নই। আমার কোনো শক্তি নেই, এমনকি তেমনই ফলপ্রসূ কর্মীও হতে পারি না তোমার রাজ্যে, যার কথা আমি সবসময় স্বপ্ন দেখেছি। আমি এই যুদ্ধটি লড়তে পারি না।

যিহোশাফাত উপলব্ধি করলেন যে এক ব্যক্তি হিসেবে তিনি একা কোনো শক্তি রাখেন না। তিনি সমস্ত জুদার মানুষকে একত্রিত করলেন, এবং সমস্ত জুদা প্রভুর সম্মুখে দাঁড়াল, তাদের ছোটবাচ্চা, তাদের স্ত্রী ও তাদের সন্তানসহ –verse 13. তারা ঐক্যতে শক্তি জানত। তারা প্রভুর সম্মুখে দাঁড়িয়ে, তিনি যাতে কথা বলেন সেই প্রত্যাশায় অপেক্ষা করছিলেন; তখন প্রভুর আত্মা নেমে এল এবং ঈশ্বর তাদেরকে সেই সহায়তা ও আশার বাক্য দিলেন যার তারা নিরাশায় অপেক্ষা করছিলেন।

…এই বিশাল সংখ্যার কারণে ভয় পেয়ো না বা হতাশ কোরো না; কারণ যুদ্ধ তোমাদের নয়, বরং ঈশ্বরের –verse 15. প্রায়ই আমি আমার যুদ্ধগুলো নিজের ভেতরে লড়াই করার চেষ্টা করি অন্যদের কাছে দুর্বল হয়ে উপস্থিত হওয়ার বদলে। কিন্তু যত তাড়াতাড়ি আমি অন্যদের আমার জীবনে এবং আমার লড়াইতে আমন্ত্রণ করি, আমি পাই ঈশ্বরের শক্তি তাঁর মানুষের মধ্যমে। যখন আমরা বিভ্রান্ত ও প্রতারিত বোধ করি, তখন আমাদের ঈশ্বরের লোকদের প্রয়োজন। আমরা সবাই একসঙ্গে প্রার্থনা করলে, আমরা পথনির্দেশনার জন্য আমাদের প্রার্থনার উত্তর পাব।

যিহোশাফাত ঈশ্বরের পরের নির্দেশ শুনলেন। আগামীকাল তোমরা তাদের বিরুদ্ধে নাম যা … তোমাদের এই যুদ্ধ লড়তে প্রয়োজন নেই: নিজেদের স্থাপন কর, স্থির হও, এবং প্রভুর ত্রাণ দেখ; …ভয় করো না, না হতাশ হও; আগামীকাল তাদের বিরুদ্ধে বের হয়ে যাও: কারণ প্রভু তোমাদের সঙ্গে থাকবে –verses 16-17. এই বাক্যগুলি আমার হৃদয়কে ভর করে। প্রায়ই সবচেয়ে সহজ কাজটি হল সমস্যার দ্রুত সমাধান খোঁজা, এমন কোনো উপায় বের করা যাতে নিজেকে এই দোলাচলে থেকে রক্ষা করা যায়, নিজেকে বোঝানো যে সবকিছু ঠিক হয়ে যাবে। কিন্তু ঈশ্বর আমার হৃদয়কে নির্দেশ দেন ভয়ে ছটফট না করে স্থির হয়ে বসতে এবং তাঁকে লড়াই করতে দিন। এটা সমস্ত কর্মশক্তি, সব কাজকর্ম এবং সমস্ত উদ্বেগের থেকেও বেশি আত্মিক শক্তি চায়; তবুও এটা অনেক বেশি ফল দেয়।

আর যিহোশাফাত মাথা নমাতেন মুখ মাটিতে করে: এবং সমস্ত জুদা ও যেরুশালেমের বাসিন্দারা প্রভুর সম্মুখে পড়ে প্রভুকে আরাধনা করল –verse 18. যদি আমি উদ্বেগের পরিবর্তে শুনি ও বিশ্বাস করি এবং কূহক হওয়ার বদলে স্থির থাকি, তাহলে আমি ঈশ্বরকে বিস্ময়কর কাজ করতে দেখবো। না, সবসময় আমার পরিস্থিতি বদলাতে বা সমস্ত কষ্ট দূর করতে নয়, কিন্তু তিনি আমার নিজের প্রাণে একটি বিস্ময়কর কাজ করেন যা আমার দৃষ্টি ও মনোভাব পরিবর্তন করে। আর তা আমাকে ও worship করায় কারণ এটি এমন এক অলৌকিক কাজ যা শুধুমাত্র সর্বশক্তিমান, সর্বশক্তিধর ঈশ্বরই করতে পারেন।

তোমরা মনে কি করো তাদের মধ্যে কেউ সেই রাতে ঘুমিয়েছে? তারা জানতেন যে এক ভয়ানক সেনা তাঁদের ধ্বংস করতে আসছে এবং তবু… তাঁরা ঈশ্বরের কথা শুনেছেন। হয়ত তাদের হৃদয়ে আনন্দিত প্রত্যাশা ছিল এবং ঈশ্বর কিভাবে এই যুদ্ধ জিতবেন তা দেখার তীব্র আকাঙ্ক্ষা। যখন আমি ছোট ছোট জিনিসে এবং জীবনে স্তূপীকৃত বড় জিনিসগুলিতে বিশ্বাস অনুশীলন করতে শিখি, তখন আমি শীঘ্রই উত্তেজিত প্রত্যাশার হৃদয় পেতে শিখব, কারণ আমি জানি তিনি কিছু করবেন! তিনি আমাকে একটি পথ দেবেন। সবচেয়ে খারাপটাও ঘটলে, তিনি আমার হৃদয়কে শান্তির পথ দেখাবেন এবং তিনি প্রতিশ্রুতি দিয়েছেন সবকিছুর মধ্য দিয়ে আমার সাথে থাকবেন। এবং সবশেষে, চূড়ান্ত বিজয় ইতিমধ্যেই জিতিয়ে দেওয়া হয়েছে, তাহলে এসব উপদ্রব আমার শান্তি ও আনন্দের সঙ্গে কী সম্পর্ক রাখে? কিছুই।

ভোর হল; এটি সেই দিন যখন ঈশ্বর তাদের বলেছিলেন যে তারা এই শত্রুদের বিরুদ্ধে যাবে। তারা দেরি না করে উঠল। তারা সবাই জানতেন সেইদিন ঈশ্বরের আশীর্বাদ পাওয়ার জন্য আজ্ঞাবহিতা ছিল সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। এবং তারা শহর থেকে বেরিয়েছিল যখন যিহোশাফাত তাদের উদ্দীপিত করলেন। এবং তারা ভোরে আগাম উঠল, … এবং তারা যখন আগাচ্ছিল, যিহোশাফাত দাঁড়িয়ে বললেন, …প্রভু তোমাদের ঈশ্বরের ওপর বিশ্বাস রাখো, তাতে তোমরা প্রতিষ্ঠিত হবে; তাঁর ভবিষ্যদ্বক্তাদের বিশ্বাস রাখো, তোমরা সফল হবে। এবং… তিনি প্রভুর জন্য গায়ক নিয়োগ করলেন, যারা পবিত্রতার সৌন্দর্যকে প্রশংসা করবে, তারা সৈন্যবাহিনীর সামনের দিকে গেয়ে চলল… – verses 21-20. তিনি যাবার সময় গাইবার জন্য গায়কদের নিয়োগ করলেন, সবকে এবং শত্রু সেনাকেও ঘোষণা করে যে তারা প্রভুর পাশে রয়েছে।

আমি দেখতে চাইতাম সেই বিশাল সেনা যখন শহর থেকে বেরিয়ে গাইছিল। তারা সামনের মুখে দাঁড়ানো একটি সম্মুখীন কাজের মুখোমুখি ছিল যা সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী মানুষকেও কাঁপিয়ে তুলত, কিন্তু তারা গান গাইছিল। এবং তারা যখন গান শুরু করল ও প্রশংসা করল, প্রভু একটি লুকোনো হামলা স্থাপন করলেন … আম্মনের সন্তানদের বিরুদ্ধে, মওব ও আমোনদের বিরুদ্ধে, …যারা জুদার বিরুদ্ধে এসেছিল; এবং তারা মারখাদাই হল … প্রত্যেকে অপরকে ধ্বংস করতে সাহায্য করল –verses 22-23.

জুদার লোকেরা তাদের প্রহরদার টাওয়ারে গিয়ে আশ্চর্য হয়ে দেখল তাদের শত্রুরা একে অপরকে ধ্বংস করেছে, এবং তাহারা কিছুই দেখল না শুধু মৃতদেহের এক সৈন্যবাহিনী। যখন আমার বিরুদ্ধে একটি ভয়ানক যুদ্ধ সাজানো হয়, তখনও আমি বিশ্বাস ও গান করার সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারি। গান করা ইচ্ছাকৃত উপাসনার কাজ; এটি আমাদের নিজের আত্মাকে এবং শুনতে থাকা প্রত্যেকটির আত্মাকে স্মরণ করায় যে প্রভু, তিনিই ঈশ্বর। তিনি আমার পরিস্থিতি, আমার ক্ষুদ্র জগৎ, ও এর সমস্ত সমস্যার সম্পূর্ণ নিয়ন্ত্রক। হঠাৎ শত্রুরা মরে যায়। পরিস্থিতি হয়ত বদলায়নি, কিন্তু যুদ্ধ আমার আত্মায় সমাপ্ত।

জুদার সেনারা পরবর্তী তিন দিন তাদের শত্রুদের মৃতদেহের ধন-দৌলত ও লুটপাট সংগ্রহ করতে কাটালেন, এতই সংগ্রহ করল যে তারা সবকিছু একসাথে বহন করেও নিতে পারল না। আশ্চর্যজনক! কিন্তু প্রতিবারই الحالই এমন। আমি যে কঠিন বিষয়গুলো সাফল্যের সঙ্গে সহ্য করি তাতে আমার আত্মা উপকৃত হয়। প্রতিটি বিজয় আমাকে ‘লোট’ জোগায় যা আমার সম্পূর্ণ জীবনের জন্য লাভজনক হবে। আমার হৃদয় আশীর্বাদে পূর্ণ, সুরক্ষিত ও এক স্বর্গীয় পিতা দ্বারা বহন কৃত। “মওব ও আমোনের সৈন্যবাহিনী” বিনাশের পরিবর্তে আশীর্বাদ নিয়ে এসেছে।

তারা আবার গান করে, ও তবলা ও শিঙ দিয়ে ভরা লুটসহ যেরুশালেমে তাদের বাড়িতে ফিরল। যখন অন্যান্য দেশে রাজ্যগুলো শুনল কিভাবে ঈশ্বর এই বিশাল যুদ্ধে লড়লেন, তখন সকলের উপরে ঈশ্বরের ভয় পড়ল, এবং তারপর যিহোশাফাতের রাজ্য শান্তি পেল। শান্তি শাসন করল।

জানার শান্তি যে সবকিছুতে আমার যা সত্যিই প্রয়োজন তা হচ্ছে ঈশ্বর এবং তাঁর কাজ — সেটাই চূড়ান্ত শান্তি। এই ভঙ্গুর জীবন সমস্ত রকম দুঃখ, রোগ ও হতাশা নিয়ে আসতে পারে, কিন্তু ঈশ্বর সেই হৃদয়কে বিশ্রাম দেয় যা একসময় বিপর্যয় ও ভয়ে ভর ছিল। চারপাশে বিশ্রাম আছে এবং "রাজ্যসমূহের সমস্ত" লোকেরা আমাদের মধ্যে থাকা শক্তিকে উৎসুক ও বিস্মিতভাবে দেখবে, কারণ সেটি এমন এক শক্তি যা কেউও মেলে ধরতে পারে না—আমাদের বিস্ময়কর ঈশ্বরের শক্তি।

For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect. For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God. …it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe –1 Corinthians –1:17-21.

The modern Christian world has duly accepted many of the lowly vehicles that God used to usher in the Kingdom. The virgin birth, the rough-hewn manger, and the swaddling clothes have become sovereign monuments that we could scarcely do without. Even the rude donkey is appreciated on Good Friday and the old, rugged cross has become a spiritual emblem nominally displayed on neck chains and ornate pulpit carvings. While man remains infatuated with the traditional symbols of the gospel, there remains an absurd avenue of God’s choosing that is becoming increasingly despised.

For centuries, the Gospel was heralded by foolish and unlearned men (according to their elite and intellectual counterparts). The biblical truth spoken in simplicity was sufficient of itself for God’s Holy Spirit to use to convert the sinner. While there is no lack for preaching in these days, it appears that much of it is of a different sort than the original form that Christ exemplified. If anyone was capable of articulating a flourish of orations in an accurate philosophical language it would have been the Apostle Paul. Yet, he refused to preach the gospel in this manner, …lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect –1 Corinthians 1:17. He preached carefully, lest the success should be ascribed to the force of art, and not of truth itself.

Paul had been ingrained in Jewish learning at the feet of Gamaliel and was affluent in understanding both Hebrew and Greek, but in preaching the cross of Christ, he laid his learning aside. He spoke the words of the Gospel in a language void of human power lest the honor belonging to Christ be eclipsed by his own personal power. For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible –2 Corinthians 10:10. It is here where the modern church has spurned the meager vehicles chosen by Christ and the Apostles while diverting to a route more acceptable to in our day. Modern day efficiency demands a more direct route to the end, and if the Bible doesn’t forbid it, we feel that it is our prerogative to employ it.

While evangelical films, music concerts, and a host of other questionable venues of ministry could be mentioned, I wish to speak primarily to the modern invitation system known as the “altar call”. While it is commonly associated with the “old fashioned meetings” of the past two centuries, it is indeed modern due to the fact that for nearly nineteen centuries no one had ever heard of the practice. Evangelists such as George Whitefield, Jonathan Edwards, and even John Wesley had never heard of such a custom. Even Charles Spurgeon (heralded as the “Prince of Preachers”) strongly criticized it and refused to adopt it.*

Thus, we observe, the practice was not born in the apostolic church. It is not found in the ministry of Jesus, His apostles, or even the church of the post-apostolic period. We do see Jesus and the apostles inviting men and women to come to Christ and to be saved, but never by means of this particular method. So why has this practice become such an essential tool in most evangelical and in many Anabaptist churches today? The answer—pragmatic results. Immediately following the sermon, the congregation will sing a hymn during which the preacher calls men and women to walk to the front of the auditorium (to the “altar”) to make a public decision for Christ. Salvation is offered to all who will but come to the front and receive it. Those who come often receive the personal attention of a counselor to pray with them and lead them through confession.

This practice was designed to encourage decisions and obtain results. So, it did. And with slight variations the new method spread with increasing popularity through Charles Finney, and later, Dwight L. Moody, and finally, into virtually all of nineteenth and twentieth century evangelicalism. Peter Cartwright, Sam Jones, R. A. Torrey, Billy Sunday, Bob Jones, Gipsy Smith, John R. Rice, Billy Graham, and George Brunk all employed the method with impressive success. Thus, the invitation system became the accepted normal practice and those who question it are often deemed spiritually eccentric.

Why should we take issue with the practice if the scripture doesn’t forbid it? The answer lies in the question of the propriety of the invitation system. Let us first note that the Scriptures abound with invitations to salvation. Such offers as, Come unto me, …and I will give you rest –Matthew 11:28, and, …If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink –John 7:37, are marvelous offers of life to those who will trust Christ. The apostles also did not hesitate to show forth Christ as Savior to all who would listen to their message.

They preached indiscriminately, Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out… –Acts 3:19, and …we pray you in Christ›s stead, be ye reconciled to God –2 Corinthians 5:20. And they testified …to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ –Acts 20:21. With all this, every Christian should not only agree but also rejoice.

Finally, …compel them to come in, that my house may be filled –Luke 14:23, is another Bible verse which could be used to lend support to the altar call method. Still, this says nothing to bolster the correctness of the altar call. As we examine the practice at its roots, we cannot help but observe a few deficiencies:

…Extra-Biblical

This is no reflection upon the multitudes who have found salvation at such an event. The angels in heaven rejoice at the repentance of every sinner no matter how he arrives there. We simply wish to hold forth the simplicity of the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe. The altar call is used as a specific addition to the sermon to bring to fruition what the foolishness of preaching itself could not do.

The altar call gained popularity in the 1830’s with the preaching of Charles G. Finney who wrote, “A revival is not a miracle, or dependent on a miracle, in any sense. It is a purely philosophical result of the right use of the constituted means.” ** We cannot accuse all who practice the altar call of believing this, but it is rather revealing that the preacher who brought it to popularity seemed to liken it more to a mathematical equation than to divine involvement.

When the truth falls on the soil of a good and honest heart, the seed veritably takes root and produces fruit. This seed of truth needs no artificial dress. It shines out with the greatest majesty in its own light and prevails in the world by its divine authority. It is a demonstration of the Spirit, without need of human invention or intervention. The plain preaching of a crucified Christ is more powerful than all the oratory, philosophical, and heart gripping modes of the world.

…Emotional Thrust

The altar call requires a seeker to leave his seat and walk to the forefront for pardon. These invitations are often preceded by fearfully moving accounts, sad stories, or testimonies that stir the emotions to fear, guilt, or regret. Flanked by a soft hymn sung by the congregation, the emotions are ripe to move forward. Those who choose to repent from their seat without responding are often esteemed as “missing an opportunity”.

And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness; And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended –Mark 4:16-17. We refuse to deduce that all who were converted under this type of ministry are stony ground hearers. Yet, the vast majority of those who receive it in such a charged emotional environment will often have a less than sincere conversion.

I once had an exuberant client in my shop who informed me that their church had sponsored a national evangelical ministry to preach at the public high school. “There were over 400 decisions for Christ!” While we all wish to rejoice with the angels, one cannot but question how many of them were still in church a year later. While the lack of true commitment may not fall upon the use of the altar call alone, we may be sure that the seed so quick to spring up will surely manifest itself at the moorings of an emotional invitation. Those that have no root would be better off never having responded prematurely.

Conversions wrought through emotional channels are often questionable and transient. Holy Spirit promptings do not need human strength, wisdom, or efforts to convey them forth. Revival methods such as shouting, overt weeping, emotion eliciting music, and the telling of sentimental stories is the man-made art of preaching. It is also found in many other public venues that are designed to elicit a specific predetermined response from the hearer. Each of these dimensions is quite natural to human behavior and, at times, there may be a fine line between what is acceptable and unacceptable in preaching. Great care should be taken that we do not create an emotional climax and eclipse the message in an inordinate manner lest the power be of men and not of Christ.

…Encroachment to Parental and Local Church Authority

Children are often a target at such a time. They may feel guilty for some childish misdeed, but a fiery message followed by emotional pleading can be very unsettling. These are times when a parent should speak to the heart of their child and connect in a spiritual way. Instead, often the child is moved to the front and given a church counselor for them to pour out their confession.

I know a woman whose father was an itinerant evangelical preacher. She claims that she responded “hundreds of times” to the altar call. A casual and honest appraisal would reveal that while the altar call may bring commencement to many sincere conversions, it also avails itself equally to a host of premature decisions and pressure-driven commitments. This often leaves many unstable souls wallowing in spiritual instability and struggling with a lack of assurance of salvation for years to come.

For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel. Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me –1 Corinthians 4:15-16. God has ordained fathers and mothers to bring birth to their children, both physical and spiritual.

Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ –1 Corinthians 11:1. The skilled itinerant evangelist has no intention of begetting spiritual children and making followers of himself. This he leaves to others, for he has found his gift in compelling people to make decisions.

And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you; And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake… –1 Thessalonians 5:13. But there is to be a God-given loyalty to those spiritual fathers who labor over us and bring us to birth beyond the many instructors upon life’s pathway. The contemporary emergence of thousands of “hit and run” ministries should cause us concern.

While public confession of sin is obviously an important doctrine of Christ to accompany salvation, these confessions belong in the hands of the spiritual authorities who can discern the situation and help further the soul through tomorrow’s temptations. When those who know the convert are personally engaged, a more thorough and honest examination can be employed to bring about a sincere conversion. This will lay the groundwork for the deep digging required to lay the foundation upon the Rock and establish the soul, both in the home and in the church.

…Engineered Faith

When people are continually subject to revival scenes, there is often an unspoken expectation that the meetings are the place to do business with God. This has a tendency to confuse “saving faith” with a “saving act”. The emphasis on “coming forward to receive Christ” confuses the meaning of faith. Christ is the strong consolation, to whom we … have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast… –Hebrews 6:18-19.(emphasis mine)

The invitation of Christ to …Come unto me… Matthew 11:28, should never be confused with “coming to the altar” (walking to the front). The foolishness of preaching is the invitation, and “Christ” is the destination. The power of the oration shall not lie in the dynamics of the preacher but within the truth of the message. We become like paper figures, having no power at all in ourselves. All power must come from above; all methods used must also come from above. –Watchman Nee ***

The wind bloweth where it listeth… John 3:8, likewise the Holy Spirit, and the preacher must be content with that. I trust that many who give altar calls have the best of intentions and do not wish to circumvent the Spirit. But most works accomplished in the apex of emotion have a strong inclination to be fallacious. So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God –Romans 10:17.

* “Charles Spurgeon, well known for his evangelistic abilities, firmly refused to adopt the practice of altar calls and he severely criticized it. He viewed the altar call as a method to force decisions as results, but he recognized its potential abuse and dangers.” Altar Calls – Bill Brenner

‘I should like to go into the enquiry-room.’ I dare say you would, but we are not willing to pander to popular superstition. We fear that in those rooms men are warmed into a fictitious confidence. Very few of the supposed converts of enquiry-rooms turn out well. Go to your God at once, even where you now are. Cast yourself on Christ, at once, ere you stir an inch!’ - Pleading and Encouragement – Charles Haddon Spurgeon – Aug 17, 1841

** What A Revival Of Religion Is – Charles Grandison Finney – The Belknap Press Of Harvard University A “Revival of Religion” presupposes a declension. Almost all the religion in the world has been produced by revivals. God has found it necessary to take advantage of the excitability there is in mankind, to produce powerful excitements among them, before he can lead them to obey. Men are so sluggish, there are so many things to lead their minds off from religion, and to oppose the influence of the gospel that it is necessary to raise an excitement among them, till the tide rises so high as to sweep away the opposing obstacles. They must be so excited that they will break over these counteracting influences, before they will obey God.

For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect. For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God. …it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe –1 Corinthians –1:17-21.

현대 기독교 세계는 하나님께서 왕국을 여는 데 사용하신 많은 보잘것없는 수단들을 상당히 받아들였습니다. 동정녀 탄생, 거칠게 깎인 구유, 그리고 포대기는 우리가 거의 없이 지내기 어려운 주권적 기념물이 되었습니다. 심지어 수수한 당나귀도 성금요일에 고마워하고 오래된 거친 십자가는 목걸이나 화려한 설교단 조각에 명목상 진열되는 영적 상징이 되었습니다. 사람이 복음의 전통적 상징들에 계속 매혹되어 있는 동안, 하나님이 선택하신 우스꽝스러운 한 경로는 점점 더 경멸받고 있습니다.

수세기 동안, 복음은 어리석고 학식 없는 사람들(그들의 엘리트적이고 지적 동료들에 따르면)에 의해 선포되었습니다. 단순함으로 말해진 성경적 진리는 그 자체로 충분하여 하나님의 성령께서 죄인을 회심시키는 데 사용하시기에 족했습니다. 오늘날 설교가 부족하지는 않지만, 그것의 많은 부분이 그리스도께서 본보이신 원형과는 다른 종류인 것으로 보입니다. 만약 누군가가 정확한 철학적 언어로 화려한 웅변을 펼칠 수 있었던 사람이라면 사도 바울이었을 것입니다. 그럼에도 그는 이런 방식으로 복음을 전하기를 거부했습니다. …lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect –1 Corinthians 1:17. 그는 성공이 인위적 기교의 힘이 아니라 진리 그 자체의 힘에 기인하도록 조심스럽게 설교했습니다.

바울은 가말리엘의 발 아래서 유대인의 학문을 익혔고 히브리어와 그리스어를 이해하는 데 유능했지만, 그리스도의 십자가를 설교할 때 그는 자신의 학식을 제쳐두었습니다. 그는 그리스도에게 속한 영예가 자신의 인적 능력에 의해 가려지지 않도록 인간의 권능이 결여된 언어로 복음의 말씀을 전했습니다. For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible –2 Corinthians 10:10. 바로 여기에서 현대 교회는 그리스도와 사도들이 선택한 보잘것없는 수단들을 멸시하고 우리 시대에 더 수용 가능한 길로 전환해 왔습니다. 현대의 효율성은 목적에 더 직접적인 길을 요구하며, 성경이 금하지 않는다면 우리가 그것을 사용할 특권이 있다고 여깁니다.

복음 영화, 음악 콘서트, 그리고 다른 많은 의심스러운 사역 장소들을 들 수 있지만, 나는 주로 “제단 부름(altar call)”로 알려진 현대식 초청 제도에 관해 말하려고 합니다. 이것은 지난 두 세기 동안의 "구식 집회"와 일반적으로 연관되지만, 사실 거의 19세기 동안 아무도 이 관습을 들어본 적이 없다는 점에서 현대적입니다. 조지 화이트필드, 조나단 에드워즈, 심지어 존 웨슬리 같은 부흥사들조차도 이러한 관습을 들어본 적이 없었습니다. 심지어 “설교자의 왕자”로 칭송받는 찰스 스펄전도 강하게 비판하며 채택을 거부했습니다.*

따라서 우리는 이 관행이 사도적 교회에서 태어나지 않았음을 관찰합니다. 그것은 예수의 사역이나 그의 사도들, 심지어 사도 이후 시기의 교회에서 발견되지 않습니다. 예수와 사도들이 사람들을 그리스도께 오라 초청하고 구원을 받으라 권한 것은 보이지만, 결코 이 특정한 방법으로는 하지 않았습니다. 그렇다면 왜 이 관습이 오늘날 대부분의 복음주의 교회와 많은 재세례파(아나밥티스트) 교회들에서 이렇게 필수적 도구가 되었을까요? 답은 — 실용적 결과입니다. 설교 직후, 회중은 찬송을 부르고 그 동안 설교자는 사람들에게 강단 앞(즉 “제단”)으로 걸어나와 그리스도를 위해 공개적으로 결단하라고 부릅니다. 구원은 앞으로 나와 받아들이기만 하면 모든 이에게 제공됩니다. 앞으로 나온 이들은 종종 상담자의 개인적 관심을 받아 기도와 고백을 인도받습니다.

이 관습은 결단을 장려하고 결과를 얻기 위해 고안되었습니다. 그래서 실제로 효과가 있었습니다. 약간의 변형을 거쳐 이 새로운 방법은 찰스 피니를 통해 인기를 얻었고, 이후 드와이트 L. 무디를 거쳐 결국 19세기와 20세기 복음주의 전반에 퍼졌습니다. 피터 카트라이트, 샘 존스, R. A. 토리, 빌리 선데이, 밥 존스, 집시 스미스, 존 R. 라이스, 빌리 그래엄, 조지 브런크 등 모두 이 방법을 인상적인 성공으로 사용했습니다. 이리하여 초청 제도는 통상적인 관행으로 받아들여졌고, 그것에 의문을 제기하는 이들은 종종 영적으로 괴벽스럽다고 여겨졌습니다.

성경이 그것을 금하지 않는다면 우리가 왜 이 관행에 문제를 삼아야 하는가? 답은 초청 제도의 적절성 문제에 있습니다. 먼저 성경에는 구원에 대한 초청이 풍성하다는 것을 주목합시다. Come unto me, …and I will give you rest –Matthew 11:28, 그리고 …If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink –John 7:37, 와 같은 제안들은 그리스도를 신뢰하는 이들에게 생명의 놀라운 제안입니다. 사도들도 그들의 메시지를 듣는 모든 이에게 주저 없이 그리스도를 구주로 제시했습니다.

그들은 무차별적으로 설교했습니다. Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out… –Acts 3:19, 그리고 …we pray you in Christ›s stead, be ye reconciled to God –2 Corinthians 5:20. 또한 그들은 증언했습니다. …to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ –Acts 20:21. 이 모든 것에 대해 모든 그리스도인은 동의할 뿐 아니라 기뻐해야 합니다.

또한 …compel them to come in, that my house may be filled –Luke 14:23는 제단 부름 방법을 지지하는 데 사용될 수 있는 다른 성구입니다. 그러나 이것은 제단 부름의 옳음을 뒷받침하지 않습니다. 그 관행의 뿌리를 살피면 몇 가지 결함을 관찰하지 않을 수 없습니다:

…성경 밖의 방법

이는 그러한 행사에서 구원을 받은 무리들을 깎아내리려는 말이 아닙니다. 천사들은 어떻게 도달했든 모든 죄인의 회개를 기뻐합니다. 우리는 단지 믿는 자들을 구원하기 위한 설교의 어리석음(보잘것없음)의 단순함을 제시하려는 것입니다. 제단 부름은 설교 자체의 어리석음만으로는 이루어지지 않는 것을 완성하기 위한 설교에 대한 특정한 추가로 사용됩니다.

제단 부름은 찰스 G. 피니의 설교와 함께 1830년대에 인기를 얻었는데 그는 이렇게 썼습니다. “A revival is not a miracle, or dependent on a miracle, in any sense. It is a purely philosophical result of the right use of the constituted means.” ** 우리는 제단 부름을 실행하는 모든 이들이 이것을 믿는다고 비난할 수는 없지만, 그것을 대중화한 설교자가 그것을 신적 개입보다 수학적 방정식에 비유한 듯한 점은 드러납니다.

진리가 선하고 정직한 마음의 토양에 떨어질 때, 그 씨는 진정으로 뿌리를 내리고 열매를 맺습니다. 이 진리의 씨는 어떤 인공적 치장이 필요 없습니다. 그것은 자체의 빛으로 가장 위엄 있게 드러나며 그 신적 권위로 세상에 통합니다. 그것은 인간의 발명이나 개입을 필요로 하지 않는 성령의 증거입니다. 십자가에 못 박히신 그리스도의 평범한 설교는 세상의 모든 웅변, 철학, 감정 자극 방식보다 더 강력합니다.

…감정적 압박

제단 부름은 찾는 이가 자기 좌석을 떠나 앞으로 걸어나와 용서를 받도록 요구합니다. 이러한 초청은 종종 두려움을 불러일으키는 이야기들, 슬픈 사연, 또는 감정을 두려움·죄책감·후회로 자극하는 간증들에 의해 선행됩니다. 회중이 부드러운 찬송을 부르는 가운데 감정이 흥분되어 앞으로 나오게 됩니다. 좌석에서 회개를 선택하고 응답하지 않는 이들은 종종 “기회를 놓쳤다”고 여겨집니다.

And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness; And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended –Mark 4:16-17. 우리는 이러한 유형의 사역 아래에서 회심한 모든 이들이 돌밭의 청취자였다고 결론짓지 않습니다. 그러나 이렇게 감정적으로 고양된 환경에서 그것을 받아들인 대부분의 사람들은 진실한 회심보다 덜 성실한 회심을 하는 경우가 많습니다.

한때 내 작업장에 열성적인 고객이 와서 그들의 교회가 공립 고등학교에서 전국적 복음 사역을 후원했다고 알려주었습니다. “그리스도를 위한 결정이 400건이 넘었어요!” 우리 모두 천사들과 함께 기뻐하고 싶지만, 그들 중 얼마나 많은 이들이 1년 후에도 교회에 남아 있었는지 의문을 갖지 않을 수 없습니다. 참된 헌신의 부족이 제단 부름의 사용만으로 발생한다고 말할 수는 없지만, 그렇게 빠르게 돋아나는 씨앗이 감정적 초청의 부두에서 분명히 드러날 것임은 확실합니다. 뿌리가 없는 자들은 성급히 응답하지 않는 편이 더 나았을 것입니다.

감정적 통로를 통해 이루어진 회심은 종종 의문스럽고 일시적입니다. 성령의 촉구는 그것을 전달하기 위해 인간의 힘, 지혜, 노력 필요로 하지 않습니다. 고함치기, 과도한 통곡, 감정을 유발하는 음악, 감상적인 이야기 전하기와 같은 부흥 방법은 인간이 만든 설교의 예술입니다. 이는 청취자로부터 특정하고 예정된 반응을 끌어내기 위해 설계된 다른 많은 공개 장소에서도 발견됩니다. 이러한 각 요소는 인간 행동에 매우 자연스러우며 때로는 설교에서 허용 가능한 것과 허용 불가능한 것 사이에 미세한 경계가 있을 수 있습니다. 우리가 감정적 절정을 만들어 메시지를 부적절하게 가리고 권능이 사람에게서 나오지 않고 그리스도에게서 나오도록 주의해야 합니다.

…부모와 지역 교회 권위에 대한 침범

어린이들은 종종 이러한 시간의 표적이 됩니다. 그들은 어떤 유치한 잘못에 대해 죄책감을 느낄 수 있지만, 불타는 메시지와 이어지는 감정적 간곡함은 매우 불안하게 만들 수 있습니다. 이러한 때에 부모는 자녀의 마음과 이야기하며 영적으로 연결해야 할 때입니다. 대신 종종 그 아이는 앞으로 끌려나와 교회 상담자에게 고백을 쏟아내게 됩니다.

나는 아버지가 유랑하는 복음 전도자인 여성 한 분을 알고 있습니다. 그녀는 자신이 제단 부름에 “수백 번” 응답했다고 주장합니다. 가볍고 정직한 평가를 하면 제단 부름이 많은 진실한 회심의 출발을 가져올 수 있는 반면, 그것은 또한 수많은 성급한 결단과 압박에 의한 헌신에도 똑같이 이용된다는 것이 드러납니다. 이는 종종 많은 불안정한 영혼들이 영적 불안정 속에서 허우적대며 수년 동안 구원의 확신 부족으로 고생하게 만듭니다.

For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel. Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me –1 Corinthians 4:15-16. 하나님은 자녀들을 육체적으로나 영적으로 낳도록 아버지와 어머니를 정하셨습니다.

Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ –1 Corinthians 11:1. 숙련된 유랑 복음전도자는 영적 자녀를 낳아 자신을 따르게 할 의도가 없습니다. 그는 사람들을 결단하게 하는 자신의 은사를 발견했고, 그 일은 다른 이들에게 맡깁니다.

And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you; And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake… –1 Thessalonians 5:13. 그러나 우리에게 수고하며 우리를 낳게 하는 영적 아버지들에게 주어진 하나님께서 주신 충성심이 있어야 합니다. 수많은 “치고 빠지는” 사역의 현대적 출현은 우리로 하여금 우려하게 해야 합니다.

죄의 공개적 고백이 분명히 구원을 동반하는 중요한 교리이기는 하나, 이러한 고백들은 상황을 분별하고 내일의 유혹을 극복하도록 영혼을 도울 수 있는 영적 권위자들의 손에 속해야 합니다. 회심자를 아는 이들이 개인적으로 관여할 때, 더 철저하고 정직한 심문을 통해 진실한 회심을 이끌어낼 수 있습니다. 이는 반석 위에 기초를 놓고 가정과 교회에서 영혼을 세우기 위해 필요한 깊은 파고들기의 기초를 놓을 것입니다.

…조작된 믿음

사람들이 계속해서 부흥 장면에 노출되면, 회중 사이에는 회중 집회가 하나님과 일할 거래를 하는 장소라는 무언의 기대가 생기는 경우가 많습니다. 이것은 ‘구원하는 믿음’을 ‘구원 행위’와 혼동하게 하는 경향이 있습니다. “그리스도를 받으러 앞으로 나오라”는 강조는 믿음의 의미를 혼동시킵니다. 그리스도는 우리가 피난처로 도망쳐 붙드는 강한 위로자이십니다. … have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast… –Hebrews 6:18-19. (강조는 필자)

그리스도의 초청인 …Come unto me… Matthew 11:28,은 결코 ‘제단으로 나아오는 것’(앞으로 걸어나오는 것)과 혼동되어서는 안 됩니다. 설교의 어리석음이 초청이며, “그리스도”가 목적지입니다. 웅변의 권능은 설교자의 역학에서가 아니라 메시지의 진리 안에 있어야 합니다. We become like paper figures, having no power at all in ourselves. All power must come from above; all methods used must also come from above. –Watchman Nee ***

The wind bloweth where it listeth… John 3:8, 성령도 그러하시며 설교자는 이에 만족해야 합니다. 나는 많은 이들이 제단 부름을 행할 때 최선의 의도를 가지고 성령을 우회하려 하지 않는다고 믿습니다. 그러나 감정의 절정에서 이루어지는 대부분의 일들은 허위일 가능성이 큽니다. So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God –Romans 10:17.

The year was around 60 AD. The Apostle Paul had been apprehended and almost killed in the Temple at Jerusalem by a mob of angry Jews.

A few days later, he had been whisked off to the Roman Procurator Felix because of danger from a group of Jewish plotters. Felix had heard his case and though there was no evidence to convict Paul, Felix had kept him in prison for the next two years until the new Procurator, Festus, took his place.

King Herod Agrippa II came to visit Festus and the two of them listened to Paul speak. During the hearing Paul …reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, [until finally] Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee –Acts 24:25. Then towards the end of Paul’s oration …Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad –Acts 26:24.

Festus was not speaking of scientific knowledge, but of the fact that Paul was well-studied. Worse yet, Paul was making the governor uncomfortable with his sinful life and his reasoning made clear that the only solution for both Festus and Agrippa was to follow the Scriptures of the Hebrews.

Paul was well educated. He made clear in his letters and sermons, quoting not only from the Jewish Bible, but also from a variety of Greek and Cretan philosophers and poets.

In more modern times, it seems as though science is not a friend to faith. Many scientists claim that the idea of an intelligent designer of the Universe is ludicrous. Further, many of them would say that those who believe such things are the next thing to savages.

It certainly turns many Christians away from science entirely. They do not see something so antagonistic to the fundamental Christian faith as being useful.

I can understand this point of view, but I think that we should not give up learning simply because some of those who claim to be so knowledgeable are, in actuality, quite foolish.

Creation

When I think about the subject of science, I often begin with the subject of creation. This is the beginning of everything and is the first place where “science” and the Bible first come into conflict.

Science is simply unable to accept that there could have been a Creator God who set in motion everything that we see.

There are many books delving into the subject of intelligent design and seeing God’s fingerprints throughout creation. It takes a lot more faith to believe that the universe happened by chance, than to believe in a Creator.

The Bible makes it clear that God was not only present at the time of Creation, but it was also He who began it (John 1:1-3). Paul says For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse –Romans 1:20.

People should be able to discern that there is a Creator God involved in our world and the universe from the time of Creation. They should be able to understand a few other things about Him as well. Perhaps most important for our discussion here, we can tell by looking at creation that God is an orderly God and that He created the world to function with a specific structure and laws that govern it.

This is one of the big differences between the Creation account found in Genesis and the myths of creation found in other cultures of the time. The Bible makes it clear that God intentionally created the world, that He did so in an orderly fashion, and that He made certain that every part of it meshed with all the other parts. There is no magic or mystical thinking in the Genesis account.

The Laws of the Universe Still Stand

There are many people who believe that they can alter the way that the universe functions, that they can behave in immoral ways and not suffer the rewards of sin, and that they can do foolish things and not suffer the consequences of their behavior.

The Prophet Jeremiah tells us that there are laws which are in place that will not cease to function. Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever –Jeremiah 31:35-36.

There is a whole set of laws that governs the way that the earth rotates on its axis and orbits the sun. Everything from the speed of light to the way that gravity pulls things towards large bodies of mass was instituted at the time of Creation—…all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation –2 Peter 3:4.

Since those laws continue and do not fluctuate, we are able to understand them—at least in part. This is what science is—the study of the natural world that we see and an attempt to comprehend the ways in which it works. God created our world in such a way that if you do an experiment the same way every time, you will get the same results every time.

Science Will Never Understand Everything

The Prophet Isaiah says, For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts –Isaiah 55:8-9.

Even the smartest quantum physicists will admit that they don’t understand everything. In fact, the number of questions that they have is greater than the whole storehouse of knowledge that has been accumulated.

Most of us will have far less understanding of the universe than that. We won’t understand all the details of how the atom functions. We won’t be able to do the calculus necessary to put a satellite into orbit. That’s all right. The important thing is that we learn what we can in order to understand what an amazing and orderly God we serve.

Presuppositions are a Problem

The biggest problem that we see in science is not the science itself, rather it is the biases of the people performing the science. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God… –Psalm 14:1. By this definition, many scientists are fools.

I don’t say this lightly. Atheists observe the universe and since they believe that there cannot be a God, they must then explain how it exists without the presence of an actual Creator. This is the heart of foolishness.

When they come to gaps in their knowledge, they are silent and yet the Christian can explain them in a few simple words. As I said before, when we look at the complexity of the universe, from the tiniest things to the largest galaxies, we can see the hands of God at work.

When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him? –Psalm 8:3-4. When we think about the world around us, when we read what scientists write, it is crucial that we come to it with a knowledge that God is behind all of this. For in him we live, and move, and have our being… – Acts 17:28, and nothing that science can discern will change that.

Science should be like a detective, uncovering God’s fingerprints on the universe, not someone bound and determined to discredit His very real presence.

Many Scientists Believe in God

Looking into the past, many scientists were men who believed in the God of the Bible. Isaac Newton, Francis Bacon, Nicholas Copernicus and many others believed in the Bible and were forthright in their expression of this faith to others.

In more modern days, there are many men and women of science who believe in the God of the Bible. Just because one is working in science doesn’t mean that they are unable to have a life of faith.

Many people have co-opted scientific discoveries to push messages that are against Christian belief and teaching.

We need to remember that when there is a set of facts, there are usually different explanations that can account for their presence. Creation and evolution examine the same facts of nature, yet from a different perspective or bias, thus they end up with vastly different conclusions. Perhaps it is a little like a Sherlock Holmes story, where Dr. Watson routinely takes the facts and gives an inaccurate explanation of them, while the detective takes the same information and gives the right explanation.

Science and Medicine

It is not against Scripture to research how things work in our universe, as long as we do so within a Biblical framework and understanding that there is a Creator God who is ordering it all.

Modern medicine is an application of many various fields, including anatomy, microanatomy, genetics, and biochemistry. The point, in this case, is to observe the human body the best that we can and then to fix the things that go wrong with it. Doctors can be scientists, but most of them are simply applying knowledge which has been passed down to them through their training.

Observation is where things start. Let’s consider diabetes as an example. Aretaeus of Cappadocia in the second century AD was the first person to give a complete description of diabetes and actually gave the disease the name diabetes. The problem was that while he was able to diagnose people with this illness, he had no treatment to help his patients. Observation had only taken him so far.

Over time, other work was done that demonstrated that the problem was an issue in the pancreas and that something was specifically wrong with the islet cells. Even into the early 1900s, there was no cure for Diabetes Mellitus and the only solution that doctors had to offer was an extremely low glycemic diet with severe calorie limits—attempting to keep patients at 500 or 600 calories a day. As can be imagined, this wasn’t an ideal treatment.

It wasn’t until the 1920s that a couple of researchers in Canada discovered a way to extract insulin from dogs and administered it to a 14-year-old who was dying of diabetes. The extract saved his life and began a new era for people with diabetes.

This is the way that things work. We begin by observing a disease and various medications that seem to be effective for it, then over time and through meticulous testing we can assess what treatments are most effective for that illness.

Studies in which half of the participants with a disease are given a medication or treatment and half are given a placebo (a pill without medical efficacy) are still the most effective way of telling whether something really works.

Why Treatments Need to be Studied

There is a real tendency to believe that the things that you have been taught are effective. We know that George Washington died of pneumonia. His doctors probably damaged his chances of recovery by bleeding him four times for a total of close to 40 percent of his blood volume. They probably would have bled him a fifth time, but he wasn’t thought to be strong enough to survive the procedure.

Doctors bled patients because they believed that there were toxic build ups in the blood stream that had to be let out. Most of the people who died after bloodletting would probably have died anyway, but bleeding people who are really sick certainly doesn’t help them recover.

Maybe the doctors simply wanted to be doing something. Patients expected bloodletting and so they met those expectations, even though it harmed the patients.

Experience is what lets you make the same mistakes with a lot more confidence.

What Makes a Good Study

Good studies—have plenty of patients in them, have a control group (that either receives an inactive pill called a placebo, or the current best treatment for that disease), and have the test group getting the new treatment. It is also important for the control group and the test group to be matched as closely as possible. Finally, the size of the groups in the study is vital to the conclusions of the study. If there are only ten or twenty patients in the study, it is not a large enough group to really sort out if something works or doesn’t.

For many diseases there is something called a placebo effect. This placebo effect is when people get better from an illness even though they are not receiving something that should be effective at treating the malady. Interestingly, in studies, many people get side effects from the inert pills. If 20 percent of the people getting the placebo get better and 45 percent of the people getting the treatment get better, that would indicate that the treatment is effective. If the difference is minimal—say 20 percent of the placebo group and 23 percent of the treatment group improve—then the treatment isn’t effective.

Problems

The biggest problem with many treatments is that they simply aren’t studied. Vitamin supplements and herbal compounds may work, but many of them have never actually been studied in a trial comparing them with a control group. Most of the information is anecdotal. The fact that someone’s grandmother or uncle benefited from something is possibly an indication that it is effective, but it doesn’t tell us how effective this treatment is or what dosage level is ideal.

Another issue is when studies simply don’t have enough participants to really give accurate information. Many studies only include ten or twenty patients. That is simply not enough to identify how well a treatment works or what side effects can be expected. For a drug to be approved by the FDA, it will typically have been studied on between 1,000 to 3,000 patients with the disease.

A final issue with studies is when they show that a medication is effective, but the effect isn’t clinically significant. As an example, a new injectable medication for dementia (aducanumab) was recently approved by the FDA. It is very expensive, and the benefit seemed to be small. Patients who were on it got an average of 1.5 more test questions right on an 85-question mental status questionnaire after 18 months compared to the control group.

One can rightly question if the benefits shown by this medication are worth the 50,000 dollar-per-year cost. More than that, how much of a meaningful improvement in someone’s everyday activities would come from using such a medicine? It seems unlikely that it would make very much of a difference.

It is unfortunate, but drug companies will always try to make it seem like their medicine is the best, even if the studies do not show significant benefit over existing, cheaper options.

Conclusion

Christians are faced with a world which does not love them or their beliefs. Many would try to use science as a way to bludgeon them into giving up their faith. I hope that does not lead us to give up on the scientific method or to give up attempting to understand the laws behind the universe that God created.

The scientific method is valid, even if many of the people who use it are atheists or agnostics. If a treatment works, it should be observable, testable, and repeatable.

Even as we approach it, we have a basic understanding of the universe that atheists don’t have. Knowing that there is a Creator God who loves us makes a major difference as we interpret the results of all the different observations that are being made in the fields of medicine and other places.

Those who do not know God are bound to be ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth –2 Timothy 3:7. On the other hand, if we begin with a Biblical understanding, we can use science as a tool to help us to understand the creation that He has placed around us.

Året var omkring 60 e.Kr. Aposteln Paulus hade blivit gripen och nästan dödad i templet i Jerusalem av en våldsam folkmassa av upprörda judar.

Några dagar senare hade han förts till den romerske procuratorn Felix på grund av fara från en grupp judiska konspiratörer. Felix hade hört hans fall och även om det inte fanns något bevis för att fälla Paulus, höll Felix honom i fängelse under de följande två åren tills den nye procuratorn, Festus, tog över.

Kungen Herodes Agrippa II kom för att besöka Festus och de två lyssnade på Paulus tala. Under förhöret …tvärrade han för rättfärdighet, sättning och kommande dom, [tills slutligen] Felix skakade i sina inälvor och svarade: Gå din väg för denna gång; när jag får en lämplig tid skall jag kalla på dig –Apostlagärningarna 24:25. Mot slutet av Paulus tal …sade Festus hög röst: Paulus, du är galen; mycket lärdom gör dig galen –Apostlagärningarna 26:24.

Festus talade inte om vetenskaplig kunskap, utan om att Paulus var väl bildad. Än värre, Paulus gjorde guvernören obekväm med hans syndiga liv och Paulus resonemang tydliggjorde att den enda lösningen för både Festus och Agrippa var att följa hebreernas skrifter.

Paulus var väl utbildad. Han gjorde det klart i sina brev och predikningar, och citerade inte bara från den judiska Bibeln utan också från en rad grekiska och kretska filosofer och poeter.

I modern tid verkar det som om vetenskap inte är en vän till tro. Många vetenskapsmän menar att idén om en intelligent skapare av universum är löjlig. Dessutom skulle många av dem säga att de som tror sådant nästan är barbarer.

Det avskräcker utan tvekan många kristna från vetenskap helt. De ser inget nyttigt i något som är så antagonistiskt mot den grundläggande kristna tron.

Jag kan förstå denna synpunkt, men jag tycker inte att vi ska ge upp att lära oss bara för att några av dem som utger sig för att vara så kunniga i verkligheten är ganska fåfänga.

Creation

När jag tänker på ämnet vetenskap börjar jag ofta med skapelsen. Detta är början på allt och är den första plats där ”vetenskapen” och Bibeln kommer i konflikt.

Vetenskapen har helt enkelt svårt att acceptera att det kunde finnas en Skapare som satte allt i rörelse som vi ser.

Det finns många böcker som fördjupar sig i ämnet intelligent design och att se Guds fingeravtryck genom skapelsen. Det krävs mycket mer tro för att tro att universum uppstod av en slump än att tro på en Skapare.

Bibeln gör det klart att Gud inte bara var närvarande vid skapelsen, utan det var också Han som började den (Johannes 1:1–3). Paulus säger Ty det osynliga hos honom, hans eviga kraft och gudom, har sedan världens skapelse kunnat ses och uppfattas i det som är skapat; så att de är utan ursäkt –Romarbrevet 1:20.

Människor borde kunna urskilja att det finns en Skapare inblandad i vår värld och universum från skapelsens början. De borde också kunna förstå några andra saker om Honom. Kanske viktigast för vår diskussion här är att vi av skapelsen kan sluta oss till att Gud är en ordnad Gud och att Han skapade världen för att fungera med en bestämd struktur och lagar som styr den.

Detta är en av de stora skillnaderna mellan skapelseberättelsen i Genesis och skapelsemyterna i andra samtida kulturer. Bibeln gör klart att Gud avsiktligt skapade världen, att Han gjorde det på ett ordnat sätt, och att Han såg till att varje del av den passade ihop med alla andra delar. Det finns ingen magi eller mystiskt tänkande i Genesis-berättelsen.

The Laws of the Universe Still Stand

Det finns många som tror att de kan ändra hur universum fungerar, att de kan bete sig omoraliskt utan att lida följderna av synd, och att de kan göra dumheter utan att drabbas av konsekvenserna av sitt handlande.

Profeten Jeremia säger oss att det finns lagar som är på plats och som inte upphör att fungera. Så säger HERREN, han som ger solen ljus på dagen och lagen för månen och stjärnorna till ljus om natten, som delar havet när dess vågor brusar — HERRENS härskarors namn är han. Om dessa stadgar försvinner framför mig, säger HERREN, då skall också Israels säd upphöra att vara ett folk inför mig för alltid –Jeremia 31:35–36.

Det finns ett helt system av lagar som styr hur jorden roterar kring sin axel och kretsar kring solen. Allt från ljusets hastighet till hur gravitationen drar saker mot stora massor instiftades vid skapelsens tid — …allt fortsätter som det varit från skapelsens början –2 Petrusbrevet 3:4.

Eftersom dessa lagar fortsätter och inte fluktuerar kan vi förstå dem — åtminstone till en del. Det är vad vetenskap är — studiet av den naturliga världen vi ser och ett försök att begripa hur den fungerar. Gud skapade vår värld så att om du utför ett experiment på samma sätt varje gång, får du samma resultat varje gång.

Science Will Never Understand Everything

Profeten Jesaja säger, Ty mina tankar är inte era tankar, och era vägar är inte mina vägar, säger HERREN. Ty liksom himlarna är högre än jorden, så är också mina vägar högre än era vägar, och mina tankar högre än era tankar –Jesaja 55:8–9.

Även de smartaste kvantfysikerna medger att de inte förstår allt. Faktum är att antalet frågor de har är större än hela den kunskapsförråd som samlats.

De flesta av oss kommer att ha mycket mindre förståelse för universum än så. Vi kommer inte att förstå alla detaljer om hur atomen fungerar. Vi kommer inte att kunna göra den kalkyl som krävs för att sätta en satellit i omloppsbana. Det är okej. Det viktiga är att vi lär oss vad vi kan för att förstå vilken underbar och ordnad Gud vi tjänar.

Presuppositions are a Problem

Det största problemet vi ser i vetenskap är inte själva vetenskapen, utan fördomarna hos dem som utför den. Dårens ord är: Ingen Gud finns — i sitt hjärta har han ingen tanke på det –Psalm 14:1. Med denna definition är många vetenskapsmän dårar.

Jag säger detta inte lättvindigt. Ateisterna iakttar universum och eftersom de tror att det inte kan finnas en Gud, måste de förklara hur det existerar utan närvaron av en verklig Skapare. Detta är själva kärnan av dårskap.

När de kommer till luckor i sin kunskap är de tysta, medan den kristne kan förklara dem med några enkla ord. Som jag sa tidigare, när vi ser på universums komplexitet, från det allra minsta till de största galaxerna, kan vi se Guds händer i verket.

När jag tänker på dina himlar, dina fingrars verk, månen och stjärnorna som du har stadgat; vad är människan, att du tänker på henne, och människosonen, att du tar hand om honom? –Psalm 8:3–4. När vi tänker på världen omkring oss, när vi läser vad vetenskapsmän skriver, är det avgörande att vi närmar oss detta med kunskapen att Gud ligger bakom allt detta. Ty i honom lever vi, rör vi oss och är vi till… –Apostlagärningarna 17:28, och inget som vetenskapen kan utröna kommer att ändra det.

Vetenskap bör vara som en detektiv som avslöjar Guds fingeravtryck på universum, inte någon beslutsam att misskreditera Hans verkliga närvaro.

Many Scientists Believe in God

Tittar man tillbaka har många vetenskapsmän varit män som trodde på Bibelns Gud. Isaac Newton, Francis Bacon, Nicolaus Copernicus och många andra trodde på Bibeln och var öppna med att uttrycka denna tro för andra.

I modern tid finns det många män och kvinnor inom vetenskapen som tror på Bibelns Gud. Bara för att man arbetar inom vetenskap betyder det inte att man inte kan ha ett liv i tro.

Många har utnyttjat vetenskapliga upptäckter för att driva budskap som är emot kristen tro och undervisning.

Vi måste komma ihåg att när det finns ett faktaunderlag finns det vanligtvis olika förklaringar som kan redogöra för dess förekomst. Skapelse och evolution undersöker samma naturfakta, men från olika perspektiv eller fördomar, och kommer därför fram till vitt skilda slutsatser. Kanske är det lite som en Sherlock Holmes-berättelse, där Dr. Watson rutinmässigt tar fakta och ger en felaktig förklaring, medan detektiven tar samma information och ger rätt förklaring.

Science and Medicine

Det strider inte mot Skriften att forska i hur saker fungerar i vårt universum, så länge vi gör det inom en biblisk ram och med förståelsen att det finns en Skapare som ordnar allt.

Modern medicin är en tillämpning av många olika fält, inklusive anatomi, mikroanatomi, genetik och biokemi. Poängen här är att observera den mänskliga kroppen så gott vi kan och sedan åtgärda det som går fel. Läkare kan vara vetenskapsmän, men de flesta tillämpar helt enkelt kunskap som förmedlats till dem genom deras utbildning.

Observation är där det börjar. Låt oss ta diabetes som exempel. Aretaeus från Kappadokien på 100-talet e.Kr. var den första som gav en fullständig beskrivning av diabetes och gav faktiskt sjukdomen namnet diabetes. Problemet var att medan han kunde diagnostisera människor med denna sjukdom hade han ingen behandling att hjälpa sina patienter. Observationen hade bara tagit honom så långt.

Med tiden gjordes annat arbete som visade att problemet låg i bukspottkörteln och att något särskilt var fel med de Langerhanska cellöarna. Även in på 1900-talet fanns ingen bot för diabetes mellitus och den enda lösning som läkarna kunde erbjuda var en extremt lågkolhydratkost med strikta kalorigränser — försöka hålla patienterna på 500 eller 600 kalorier per dag. Som man kan föreställa sig var detta inte en ideal behandling.

Först på 1920-talet upptäckte några forskare i Kanada ett sätt att utvinna insulin från hundar och gav det till en 14-åring som höll på att dö av diabetes. Extraktet räddade hans liv och inledde en ny era för människor med diabetes.

Så fungerar det. Vi börjar med att observera en sjukdom och olika läkemedel som verkar effektiva mot den, och sedan kan vi över tid och genom noggranna tester bedöma vilka behandlingar som är mest effektiva för den sjukdomen.

Studier där hälften av deltagarna med en sjukdom får ett läkemedel eller en behandling och hälften får en placebo (en tablett utan medicinsk verkan) är fortfarande det mest effektiva sättet att avgöra om något verkligen fungerar.

Why Treatments Need to be Studied

Det finns en stark tendens att tro att det som man blivit undervisad om är effektivt. Vi vet att George Washington dog av lunginflammation. Hans läkare skadade förmodligen hans chanser till återhämtning genom att låta blod honom fyra gånger till en total nära 40 procent av hans blodvolym. De skulle förmodligen ha tappat honom en femte gång, men man trodde inte att han var tillräckligt stark för att överleva proceduren.

Läkare tappade patienter för att de trodde att det fanns giftiga ansamlingar i blodet som måste släppas ut. De flesta som dog efter blodutmärktning skulle förmodligen ha dött ändå, men att tappna svårt sjuka människor hjälper dem inte att återhämta sig.

Kanske ville läkarna helt enkelt göra något. Patienterna förväntade sig blodtappning och därför mötte läkarna dessa förväntningar, även om det skadade patienterna.

Erfarenhet är vad som låter dig göra samma misstag med mycket större säkerhet.

What Makes a Good Study

Goda studier har många patienter, en kontrollgrupp (som antingen får ett inaktivt piller kallat placebo, eller den nuvarande bästa behandlingen för den sjukdomen), och en testgrupp som får den nya behandlingen. Det är också viktigt att kontrollgruppen och testgruppen är så väl matchade som möjligt. Slutligen är gruppstorleken i studien avgörande för studiens slutsatser. Om det bara finns tio eller tjugo patienter i studien är det inte tillräckligt stort för att verkligen avgöra om något fungerar eller inte.

För många sjukdomar finns något som kallas placeboeffekt. Denna effekt är när människor blir bättre från en sjukdom även om de inte får något som borde vara effektivt mot åkomman. Intressant nog får många i studier biverkningar från de inerta pillren. Om 20 procent av dem som får placebo blir bättre och 45 procent av dem som får behandlingen blir bättre, skulle det tyda på att behandlingen är effektiv. Om skillnaden är liten — säg 20 procent i placebogruppen och 23 procent i behandlingsgruppen förbättras — så är behandlingen inte effektiv.

Problems

Det största problemet med många behandlingar är att de helt enkelt inte är studerade. Vitamintillskott och örtpreparat kan fungera, men många av dem har aldrig blivit studerade i en prövning där de jämförts med en kontrollgrupp. Det mesta av informationen är anekdotisk. Det faktum att någons farmor eller farbror hade nytta av något är möjligen en indikation på att det är effektivt, men det säger inget om hur effektiv behandlingen är eller vilken dos som är ideal.

En annan fråga är när studier helt enkelt inte har tillräckligt många deltagare för att ge tillförlitlig information. Många studier inkluderar bara tio eller tjugo patienter. Det räcker helt enkelt inte för att identifiera hur väl en behandling fungerar eller vilka biverkningar som kan förväntas. För att ett läkemedel ska godkännas av FDA har det vanligtvis studerats på mellan 1 000 och 3 000 patienter med sjukdomen.

En sista fråga med studier är när de visar att ett läkemedel är effektivt, men effekten inte är kliniskt signifikant. Som exempel godkändes nyligen ett nytt injicerbart läkemedel mot demens (aducanumab) av FDA. Det är mycket dyrt och vinsten verkade vara liten. Patienter som fick det fick i genomsnitt 1,5 fler rätt på ett 85-fråge långt kognitivt test efter 18 månader jämfört med kontrollgruppen.

Man kan med rätta ifrågasätta om de vinster som visats av detta läkemedel är värda en kostnad på 50 000 dollar per år. Mer än så, hur mycket meningsfull förbättring i någons vardagliga aktiviteter skulle komma från att använda ett sådant läkemedel? Det verkar osannolikt att det skulle göra särskilt stor skillnad.

Det är beklagligt, men läkemedelsföretag kommer alltid att försöka få det att framstå som om deras medicin är bäst, även om studierna inte visar på betydande fördel jämfört med befintliga, billigare alternativ.

Conclusion

Kristna står inför en värld som varken älskar dem eller deras övertygelser. Många kommer att försöka använda vetenskap som ett sätt att tvinga dem att överge sin tro. Jag hoppas att det inte leder oss till att överge den vetenskapliga metoden eller att sluta försöka förstå de lagar som styr universum som Gud skapade.

Den vetenskapliga metoden är giltig, även om många av dem som använder den är ateister eller agnostiker. Om en behandling fungerar bör den vara observerbar, testbar och reproducerbar.

Även när vi närmar oss den har vi en grundläggande förståelse av universum som ateister inte har. Att veta att det finns en Skapare som älskar oss gör en stor skillnad när vi tolkar resultaten av alla de olika observationer som görs inom medicin och andra områden.

De som inte känner Gud är dömda att vara alltid lärande men aldrig kunna nå kunskap om sanningen –2 Timoteusbrevet 3:7. Å andra sidan, om vi börjar med en biblisk förståelse kan vi använda vetenskap som ett verktyg för att hjälpa oss att förstå den skapelse som Han har lagt omkring oss.

Greetings of brotherly love to one and all. The year 2022 is almost gone. A lot has happened. Another year of devastating storms, floods, fires, earthquakes, wars, and rumors of wars. America has gone through another season of political elections, causing the conservatives and liberals to become even more polarized into opposing parties.

Recently, I have been reflecting on the current status of life as a committed Bible-believing Christian in our world today. Sure, there are certain places in our world where Christians live in constant threat of imprisonment or death simply because they are trying to live according to God’s Word. However, the world, seems to be moving towards an increasingly negative perspective of God’s people. In an increasingly developing trend, there is a surprising rise of hostility towards the committed believer.

What is happening? I have had numerous conversations with various believers from around the country who seem to have a growing alarm about the current victorious march of evil over good, of liberal agendas over a conservative lifestyle, and the list goes on. Current skyrocketing inflation, the potential of unprecedented heating costs for many, the rumors of rising interest rates, and the ongoing shortage of goods all tend to cause a person to be jolted out of a sense of normality.

For us as Christians, let us always keep our focus fixed on the God of heaven. This is the God that Paul declared on Mars Hill—God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands; Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things; –Acts 17:24-25.

Let’s stop focusing on the fact that evil seems to be prevailing and increasing around us and then concluding that somehow Satan has the upper hand right now. Rather, let us be reminded about what God’s Word says. But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived. But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them; And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus. All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works –2 Timothy 3:13-17.

Let us keep our eyes fixed on Jesus …the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God –Hebrews 12:2. Instead of believing Satan’s lie that he is somehow winning the battle for Truth right now, let’s remember that the Bible reveals that Satan can do nothing without God allowing him a temporary free rein. It seemed to those looking on that Satan had the complete upper hand when Jesus was crucified and buried. Surprise, surprise! Satan had unwittingly allowed God to use him to accomplish everything that had been prophesied throughout the Scriptures. It is the same today… God will again allow Satan whatever free rein is necessary to bring to fulfillment all that the Bible has foretold will come to pass regarding the end of time.

In this issue of the magazine, we have once more endeavored to bring you information in the articles that is both helpful and relevant to our time in history. Brother Leonard Martin, a bishop in one of our churches has shared an exhortation on spiritual gifts in the church with a number of clear, practical observations for us today. The article that we have chosen to share from “Bible Helps” in this issue is one of the best discourses on the subject of “faith and works” that I have ever read. The writer even delves, with biblical simplicity and clarity, into the controversial subjects of divine election and predestination. Finally, we have The Foolishness of Preaching an evaluation regarding the basis of churches using “the altar call”—is it founded in the Scriptures and the history of the church or is it a method that the church has borrowed from the world in more recent years?!

All of this is sure to stir thoughts and discussion—which is our goal with these types of articles. Please feel free to respond via email or regular mail with your thoughts of caution or encouragement. This is helpful for us and our writers. When you write, we also ask that you mention yes or no if we can use your questions or comments in our magazine. We have had various requests to establish a section in our magazine dedicated to hearing from our readers.

One final thought… over the years our readers have, at times, shared with us ways that they think we could improve our magazine for the good of all who read it and to present a more clear gospel message. We welcome this to continue.

May God richly bless each of you,

Curvin L. Wenger

Salamu za upendo wa ukaribu kwa kila mmoja. Mwaka wa 2022 karibu umeisha. Mengi yamekutokea. Mwaka mwingine wa vimbunga vinavyoharibu, mafuriko, moto, mitetemeko ya ardhi, vita, na uvumi wa vita. Marekani imepitia msimu mwingine wa uchaguzi wa kisiasa, ikisababisha wahafidhina na waliberali kuendelea kugeukana wapinzani zaidi.

Hivi karibuni, nimekuwa nikitafakari kuhusu hali ya sasa ya maisha kama Mkristo mwaminifu anayemwamini Biblia katika dunia yetu ya leo. Bila shaka, kuna sehemu fulani duniani ambako Wakristo wanaishi kwa hatari ya kufungwa gerezani au kuuawa kwa sababu tu wanajaribu kuishi kulingana na Neno la Mungu. Hata hivyo, dunia inaonekana kuiangalia jamii ya Mungu kwa mtazamo unaoongezeka kuwa hasi. Katika mwelekeo unaoendelea, kuna kuongezeka kwa ghadhabu dhidi ya muumini mwenye bidii.

Nini kinaendelea kutokea? Nimekuwa na mazungumzo mengi na waumini mbalimbali kutoka mikoani kote ambao wanaonekana kuwa na wasiwasi unaoongezeka kuhusu kuendelea kushinda kwa uovu juu ya wema, sera za ukombozi wa kijamii juu ya mtindo wa maisha wa kihafidhina, na orodha inaendelea. Kuinuka kwa bei kwa sasa, uwezekano wa gharama za kupasha nyumba za kiwango kisicho cha kawaida kwa wengi, uvumi wa kuongezeka kwa riba, na uhaba unaoendelea wa bidhaa vinavyosababisha mtu kutokwa na mhemko kutokana na kuporomoka kwa hali ya kawaida.

Kama Wakristo, tuwe kila wakati tukitazama kwa makini kwa Mungu wa mbinguni. Huyu ndiye Mungu aliyehubiriwa na Paulo katika Hekalu la Mars —Mungu ambaye aliumba dunia na vitu vyote vilivyo ndani yake; kwa kuwa yeye ndiye Bwana wa mbingu na duniani, hajazi ndani ya makanisa yaliyotengenezwa kwa mikono; wala hajumuimbiwi kwa mikono ya watu, kana kwamba anahitaji kitu chochote; kwa kuwa yeye hutoa kwa wote uhai, na pumzi, na vitu vyote; – Matendo 17:24-25.

Tusizoee kutegemea ukweli kwamba uovu unaonekana kushinda na kuongezeka mzunguko wetu na kisha kusema kwamba kwa namna fulani Shetani anaumiliki sasa. Badala yake, tukumbushwe kile Neno la Mungu linasema. Lakini watu wabaya na watoza watakuwa waovu zaidi zaidi, wakidanganya, na wajidanganye wenyewe. Lakini wewe endelea katika mambo uliyofundishwa na uliyoyatambua, ukijua kutoka nani umejifunza haya; Na tangu utoto umewajua maandiko matakatifu, ambayo yanaweza kukufanya kuwa mwenye busara kwa wokovu kupitia imani iliyomo katika Kristo Yesu. Maandiko yote yametolewa kwa ufunuo wa Mungu, na yanafaa kwa mafundisho, kwa kutoa lawama, kwa marekebisho, kwa mafundisho katika haki: Ili mtu wa Mungu awe mkamilifu, amekamilishwa kwa kazi zote njema – 2 Timotheo 3:13-17.

Tuyapimize macho yetu kwa Yesu …mwandishi na mfinyazo wa imani yetu; ambaye kwa furaha iliyokuwa mbele yake alivumilia msalaba, akadharau aibu, na ameketi upande wa kulia wa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu – Wabiblia 12:2. Badala ya kuamini uwongo wa Shetani kwamba kwa namna fulani anashinda vita ya Ukweli sasa hivi, tukumbuke kwamba Biblia inaonyesha kuwa Shetani hawezi kufanya chochote bila Mungu kumruhusu kwa muda ujazo wa uhuru. Ilionekana kwa walioangalia kuwa Shetani alikuwa na nguvu kabisa wakati Yesu alikulikwa msalabani na kuzikwa. Ajabu, ajabu! Shetani kwa kutotaka alimiruhusu Mungu kumtumia kutimiza kila kitu kilichotabiriwa katika Maandiko. Ni sawa leo… Mungu atamruhusu tena Shetani uhuru wowote unaohitajika ili kuleta kutimizwa kwa yote ambayo Biblia imetabiri yatatokea kuhusu mwisho wa nyakati.

Katika toleo hili la jarida, tumejaribu tena kukuletea habari katika makala ambazo ni za msaada na zinazohusiana na wakati wetu katika historia. Kaka Leonard Martin, mchungaji mmoja katika makanisa yetu, amegawana wito wa kuhamasisha kuhusu vipawa vya kiroho ndani ya kanisa pamoja na uchunguzi kadhaa wazi, wa vitendo kwetu leo. Makala tunayochagua kushirikisha kutoka “Bible Helps” katika toleo hili ni mojawapo ya mihadhara bora kuhusu mada ya “imani na matendo” ambayo nimewahi kusoma. Mwandishi hata anakagua, kwa unyenyekevu na uwazi wa kibiblia, mada zinazokatisha tamaa za uteuzi wa kiungu na ulango wa awali wa wokovu. Mwishowe, Tunachoita Upotovu wa Kutangazwa kwa Injili (The Foolishness of Preaching) ni tathmini kuhusu msingi wa makanisa kutumia “wito wa madhabahu”—je, umeanzishwa katika Maandiko na historia ya kanisa au ni njia ambayo kanisa limekopa kutoka kwa dunia katika miaka ya hivi karibuni?!

Yote haya yatahisi nadharia na mijadala—ambayo ni lengo letu kwa aina hizi za makala. Tafadhali jisikie huru kujibu kupitia barua pepe au barua za kawaida kwa mawazo yako ya tahadhari au faraja. Hii ni ya msaada kwetu sisi na waandishi wetu. Unapoandika, tunaomba pia ueleze ndiyo au hapana ikiwa tunaweza kutumia maswali yako au maoni yako katika jarida letu. Tumepokea maombi mbalimbali ya kuanzisha sehemu katika jarida letu iliyotengwa kusikiliza kutoka kwa wasomaji wetu.

Fikiria moja ya mwisho… kwa miaka, wasomaji wetu wakati mwingine wametushirikisha njia wanazodhani tunaweza kuboresha jarida letu kwa ajili ya wema wa wote wanaosoma na kutoa ujumbe wa injili ulioweka wazi zaidi. Tunakaribisha hili liendelee.

Mungu awabariki kwa wingi kila mmoja wenu,

Curvin L. Wenger
